title: Nvidia Just Built the Brain of a Windows Laptop
description:
Microsoft opened pre-orders for the Surface Laptop Ultra ($2,599+), built on Nvidia's new Arm-based RTX Spark superchip.
Up to 20 CPU cores, 6,144 Blackwell GPU cores and 128 GB of unified memory, enough for Microsoft's claim of 120B-parameter AI models running on the laptop. RTX Spark laptops ship October 16.
